Hitting an enemy with a Centipede Skill reduces their Damage by 4.0%, Slows them by 10%, and deals {x} Poisoning damage over 8 seconds, stacking up to 8 times.

All Skills are now also Centipede Skills.

detail:
Casting an Eagle Skill or Evading shoots {x} Storm Feathers, each dealing {x} Lightning damage and applying Vulnerable for 5 seconds. Can only occur once every 0.5 seconds. The Storm Feathers Movement Speed bonus is doubled and always active.

All Skills are now also Eagle Skills.

entries.name: spiritborn_jaguar_moon_passive

detail:
Every 15th time you deal direct damage with a Jaguar Skill, unleash a Beat Strike dealing {x} damage, increasing all damage you deal by 3%[x] and doubling each subsequent Beat Strike's damage, stacking 5 times. You lose all stacks when you stop attacking for 1 second.

All Skills are now also Jaguar Skills.
